trend_engine_summary.ranking_rule: Background Trend Engine score only. It does not create, veto, or replace the primary Sniper 1H BUY/SELL signal.
trend_engine_summary.qualification_rule: BUY requires bullish 4H and 1H plus TE score >=75. SELL requires bearish 4H and 1H plus TE score >=75. Top lists are up to 10 and are never padded with non-qualifying assets.

action_report.ranking_policy: NEW > RETEST > ACTIVE_PRE_TP5 > RECENT_JOAT_TRIGGER_<=4H > JOAT_AT_SIGNAL > 4H_TREND_STRENGTH > EXTENSION_TIEBREAKER
action_report.joat_visibility: SEPARATE JOAT_AT_SIGNAL + JOAT_RECENT_TRIGGER_<=4H + JOAT_CURRENT ON EVERY SNIPER ROW
action_report.joat_recent_trigger_policy: VOL_CONFIRMED directional cross only; age 0-2H = FRESH, age 3-4H = RECENT, >4H = HISTORICAL_ONLY. Visibility/ranking overlay only; never creates or vetoes Sniper.
